A1.justification: Both PDFs describe CollabLLM and contain complete main text and Appendices A–F. Text, equations, tables, and figures can be reliably matched across versions.

before.justification: v2 reports original simulated benchmark evaluations, Abg-CoQA generalization results, a 201-participant user study, reward ablations, and appendix safety experiments.

after.justification: v3 retains original benchmark and generalization results, the 201-participant user study, and the appendix ablation and safety results.

M1.justification: The multiturn-aware rewards, forward simulation, reward components, and SFT/DPO/PPO procedures are unchanged. The added '-Instruct' suffix clarifies model identification without documenting a new method component or procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use MediumDocEdit-Chat, BigCodeBench-Chat, MATH-Chat, Abg-CoQA, the human document-writing study, and the same four-category adversarial safety evaluation.

E2.justification: The comparator membership remains Base, Proactive Base, and GPT-4o in the Abg-CoQA comparison. Llama baseline labels become Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct in the corresponding passages and Tables 2 and 8; no comparator or baseline procedure is added or removed.

E3.justification: Sample counts, metrics, training budgets in Table 6, user-study procedures, and the 80-query safety protocol are unchanged. The more explicit Instruct designation is consistent with v2's existing description of safety-aligned models and does not document a changed experimental configuration.

E4.justification: Reward and window-size ablations in Figures 4 and 9, the coding case study, computational-cost analysis, safety tests, and simulated-versus-real-user analysis are retained. Section 5.1 changes its figure references without adding or removing an analysis.

E5.justification: Table 5 retains the same mean-and-standard-deviation reporting, and Figure 7 retains its distributions and error bars. No run counts, seeds, uncertainty estimates, or statistical testing procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical and qualitative result entries are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 2 retains CollabLLM's 62.58% macro accuracy, and Appendix C retains the 99.7% safety pass rate for both models.

T1.justification: The problem formulation, reward definitions in Equations 1–4, and causal-inference expression and reasoning in Appendix A remain unchanged. No mathematical assumption, derivation, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about collaboration, efficiency, interactivity, generalization, and user-study improvements.

C2.justification: Interpretations of reward mechanisms, generalization, user experience, and safety are unchanged. The simulator limitations in Appendix B.2 and simulated-versus-real-user discussion in Appendix F.2 are also retained.

D1.justification: Section 4 and Appendix C explicitly identify Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct instead of Llama-3.1-8B, making the checkpoint used for fine-tuning and comparisons more precise. Hyperparameters, costs, prompts, and code/data access disclosures otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, related-work discussion, Table 4 comparison, and Appendix A.2 positioning are unchanged. The added acknowledgments do not introduce cited research.

P1.justification: Limited edits standardize model names, change two Section 5.1 references from Figure 9 to Figure 4, remove 'proactively' from one sentence, and add Giovanni Monea and Alessandro Sordoni to the acknowledgments. The section structure and substantive prose are retained.

P2.justification: Tables 2 and 8 receive revised model labels, with Table 8 widening. Text reflows locally across the acknowledgments and appendices. All figures and tables remain present, and the figure graphics are unchanged.

improvement.justification: Explicitly identifying Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct reduces checkpoint ambiguity and improves reproducibility and interpretation of the baseline and safety comparisons. Updating Section 5.1 to reference the main-text ablation figure also improves navigation. These are limited documentation gains; the scientific evidence and conclusions remain unchanged.
